# tui-log-viewer

> Terminal log viewer core that tails, pages and filters multi-gigabyte files through bounded reads, with level highlighting and a follow mode that survives truncation Rust crate `trysac-tui-log-viewer`, library `tui_log_viewer`, MIT licensed,
> Rust >= 1.88 (edition 2024), standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
